<reason>PRO won the central comparison. CON conceded the peer-supplier distance helps deter initiation but never showed 21-alone could remove that replenished supplier, while PRO showed the legal pool only shrinks and possession is not criminalized, blunting fairness and black-market fears. CON's proportionality and older-nonsmoker vs younger-dependent objection stayed live but was outweighed by trajectory: leak while winding to zero vs leak while refilling forever.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO's peer-pipeline reply that the supplier is barely-legal friends, so a cutoff removes the socially close source while 21 replenishes it yearly, which CON later conceded as an advantage and never fully answered.</best_rebuttal>
